schema.CATEGORICAL_MODEL_COLS: list[str] - 7 categorical application columns, one-hot encoded during transform
schema.NUMERIC_RAW_COLS: list[str] - 25 numeric application inputs expected from Module 1
schema.FAIRNESS_ONLY_COLS: list[str] - dropped before fit and transform output
schema.FORBIDDEN_COLS: list[str] - never emitted in model outputs
schema.FrozenFeatureBuilder: dataclass containing frozen rare maps, missing-flag policy, imputers, frozen output columns, numeric scale columns, scaler, and FULL aggregate metadata

envVars.DATA_PROCESSED_DIR: Optional processed split root used by inline Stage 4 validation; defaults to data/processed/
envVars.DATA_RAW_DIR: Operational path concept for raw CSV access; fit_full_builder and offline FULL transforms use the raw_dir argument directly

dependencies.joblib: runtime dependency for persisted builder artifacts
